:::{#exm-existential-quantifier}
#### An existentially quantified proposition

Let $P(x)$ be the predicate "$x$ is [even](number-systems.qmd#def-even-odd)".

- "$\exists x \in \cb{1, 2, 3}, P(x)$" is true, because $P(2)$ is true.
- "$\exists x \in \cb{1, 3, 5}, P(x)$" is false, because none of $1$, $3$, and $5$ is even.

:::
